name: Jiangsu Xinde Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Silicon Integrity Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures semiconductor equipment. It offers products, such as JSSI Turn-key Technical Solution, JSSI For Bumping, JSSI Product Test Capability, JSSI For WLCSP, JSSI For BGA, and JSSI Core Equipment for Traditional Package. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Nanjing, China.
